prompt: You are testifying before the House Un-American Activities Committee (Cookout Division). It has been alleged that your truck is a rental. Respond to the committee.
response: I am not now, nor have I ever been, in possession of a rental truck. The vehicle in question is a cherished member of my extended family, purchased outright with cash I earned through honest, all-American labor. The only thing "rented" here is this line of questioning, which seems to have been leased from a fishing expedition. I stand by my truck, my driving record, and my constitutional right to transport an unreasonable amount of potato salad without persecution.
